description:
Retire the research stub's parallel PackedField/PackedFieldVec trait declarations so the production traits in gf2-algebra are the only live declaration in the tree.

## Background

`dev/research/packed_field_stub/` is the historical demonstration crate that proved the packed trait surface before production adoption; it still redeclares `PackedField` and `PackedFieldVec` and carries stub `fold_mul` bodies that return zero. The production surface lives in `crates/gf2-algebra/src/packed/mod.rs`. The capability classification document records the cutover disposition for this variant; the default action is archival under dev/archive with a pointer to the production home, preserving the original design-record linkage.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The tree outside dev/archive contains exactly one declaration of the packed lane traits, in gf2-algebra.
- [hard] REQ-02: The stub's historical role and its design-record linkage remain discoverable from the archived location, and no document outside dev/archive refers to the stub as a live artifact.
title: Retire the packed-trait parallel declarations in the research stub
